$description: Citation ledger for build-time evidence OUTSIDE this folder (the sibling clone project) plus evidence copied INSIDE it (@repo/extraction/evidence). Paths without @repo/ are relative to the clone project root (the parent of design-repo/). verify_all.py resolves every citation and checks that `expect` appears in the cited line range; when the sibling project is absent it WARNS and skips external citations instead of failing.

sourceProject.name: Flashform clone
sourceProject.vcs: none - the project folder is not a git repository, so design-repo.zip can never be committed alongside the live folder.

policies.maxWords: maxWords = observedMaxWords + max(1, ceil(observedMaxWords * 0.2)). observedMaxWords is the longest instance of that field in the real page (example.pagespec.json). A design decision, applied uniformly; not a measured value.
policies.evidencePriority: QA Playwright measurements of the live original > reference/original-entry CSS/JS > src/ (the port) > CLONE_SPEC.md prose.
